body: Largest independent precision bearing-cage maker (brass/steel/polyamide, 20-2,000 mm, 7,500+ designs); bushings (wind), stampings, solar EPC. Plants: Changodar, Moraiya, Bhayla (Advantek) in Ahmedabad; Changshu, China; Ghimbav, Romania. IPO Sep-2022 at Rs 330. Promoters 75% (Rangwala/Shah families). FY26 revenue Rs 1,627 cr, PAT Rs 155 cr. Live deep dive #6 (2026-11-25).
title: Harsha Engineers International Ltd (NSE: HARSHA, BSE: 543600)
